data.text:
### Opportunity
Develop a 60 IT MW hyperscale data centre requiring USD 750m capex. Implementing liquid cooling across 1,333 racks (45 kW/rack), the design beats IMDA DC-CFA targets with a 1.18 PUE and positions the project for BCA Green Mark Platinum status.

### Site
Site A · Ubi Road 1 (evaluation score: 95.1) spans a 40,800 m² parcel with mature fibre ecosystems. It is situated 476 m from Paya Lebar 400kV Substation—utilising a dedicated 66 kV intake to serve the 70.8 MW facility load—and 185 m from Vertex Block B.

### Design
The 2-storey, 15.5 m tall development encompasses 26,626 m² GFA, a 12,750 m² footprint (42% coverage), and a 0.65 plot ratio. It delivers 15,000 m² of white space across 4 halls with N+1 redundancy. Annual resource usage equates to 496 GWh energy, 99,233 m³ water (0.2 WUE), and 206,802 T carbon.

### Risks
Fuel storage for the 34 standby diesel generators exceeds standard thresholds, generating a compliance advisory that mandates a formal SCDF Petroleum and Flammable Materials licence.

### Next steps
Secure the SCDF Petroleum and Flammable Materials licence for the 34 gensets and advance SP Group / EMA grid intake execution.

data.text:
### Opportunity
Deployment of a $750m USD, 60 IT MW (70.8 MW facility load) hyperscale facility generating 496 GWh annually. *(Note: SiteScout lists Site A at Ubi Road 1 as the prime recommendation).*

### Site
**Site F · International Business Park** (Score: 80.6). The parcel measures 240 m × 170 m (40,800 m²), situated 108 m from Jurong Data Center and 2,249 m from Clementi Substation.

### Design
- **Structure:** 2 storeys, 15.5 m height, 0 rotation, 26,626 m² GFA, 12,750 m² footprint (42% coverage, 0.65 plot ratio).
- **IT & Whitespace:** 4 halls, 15,000 m² white space, housing 1,333 racks at 45 kW/rack with N+1 redundancy.
- **Cooling & Efficiency:** Closed-loop liquid cooling delivering a 1.18 PUE (meets DC-CFA 1.30 mandate and BCA Green Mark Platinum) and 0.2 WUE (99,233 m³ annual water use).

### Risks
Compliance status is **warn**:
- **Grid Connection:** 70.8 MW facility load mandates a dedicated 66 kV intake traversing 2,249 m from Clementi Substation (SP Group / EMA).
- **Fuel Storage:** 34 backup gensets exceed bulk diesel limits, requiring SCDF PFM storage licensing and a Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA).
- **Emissions & Noise:** Annual emissions of 206,802 tCO2e trigger mandatory reporting under NEA’s Carbon Pricing Act (>25,000 tCO2e threshold); acoustic containment is required for the 34 gensets (residential buffer score: 99/100).

### Next steps
Secure SP Group/EMA 66 kV intake approvals, complete SCDF PFM storage licensing and QRA, and establish NEA emissions reporting.
